_note: LIVE CONNECTOR + BINDING REGISTRY — the single source for which MCP/analytics/store binding lives on which provider, plus the concrete live IDs (Clarity project ids, analytics login, Shopify stores/themes, Slack channel). Policy prose used to hardcode these and went stale; now prose points here and `bin/connectors.py` renders paste-ready blocks (bot allowlists, ticket templates) from this file. `available_on` is dynamic: when a connector moves seats, edit ONLY this file. This file holds NO secrets — connector NAMES and public IDs only; keys/tokens never live in the repo (see .gitignore, EDGE-CASES §Secrets).

gsc-indexing.note: Read-only roles MUST deny every mutating tool (enforced by generate-roles.py).

clarity-magnetbaron.note: MCP-judgment seats only, and only dashboard + a handful of flagged recordings. Bulk recording pulls (up to 250 rows) are a banned row-dump — park volume; Heat Map bot handles browser-only layers.

clarity.least_privilege_note: server@ carries NO Google-service data/roles beyond the two Clarity invites; the bot holds a live Google session, so a broad account would be a prompt-injection blast radius.
clarity.role: Member (Clarity has no read-only role); bot never changes settings/members/data

magnet-baron.preview_extra: preview_theme_id=* on an approved live host

gadget-duke.preview_extra: preview_theme_id=* on an approved live host

main.role: owner review preview; only owner-approved merges land

experimental.role: Review D staging; safe to merge candidate branches anytime

gadget-duke.staging_note: experimental is a staging lane, never a source of truth; canonical change still lands via its own PR to main.

slack.coexistence: Two Grok Bot identities (Review D + Heat Map) share this ONE public channel and post under the same Slack identity; they coexist by CONTENT tokens (shopifypreview.com ticket shape vs a message starting with 'clarity deep-dive:'), never by author. Never split to a second channel or Slack-Connect it.

render_targets.visual-qa-allowlist: bin/connectors.py --render visual-qa-allowlist  → paste-ready Review D allowlist block
render_targets.visual-qa-ticket: bin/connectors.py --render visual-qa-ticket <store>  → paste-ready Slack ticket template
render_targets.clarity: bin/connectors.py --render clarity  → Heat Map project/login binding
